104653.ch: 没想到你的{relation|C|A}{name|C}竟然是我{school|C}的{post|C}，但你为何只是一介散修呢？

104654.en: We have so much in common, it does not matter that we have not met before. Hopefully one day, {call|B|A}, we can both join a powerful Sect.
104654.ch: 同是天涯沦落人，相逢何必曾相识？{call|B|A}，希望有朝一日我们都能加入强大的宗门。

104655.en: Us Rogue Cultivators should stick together!
104655.ch: 我等散修之间，可要互相扶持呀！

104656.en: As a fellow Rogue Cultivator, feel free to seek me out if you hit any sticking points.
104656.ch: 同为散修，修行若是有何不通之处，可来寻我。

104657.en: {call|B|A}, both of us might be Rogue Cultivators, but we differ in one respect—my {relation|C|B} {name|C} is {post|C} at {school|C}!
104657.ch: {call|B|A}，虽然你我都是散修，有点我却与你不同，我{relation|C|B}{name|C}是{school|C}的{post|C}！

104658.en: I might be a Rogue Cultivator, but I have lots of contacts at {school|C}, including one who is a {post|C}. {gender|C} is a {grade|C} Cultivator!
104658.ch: 我虽与你一样是散修，但我的亲友众多，皆入了{school|C}，其中身份最高的已经成为{post|C}了，{gender|C}是{grade|C}强者！

104659.en: {call|B|A}, seeing we are fellow Rogue Cultivators, for your sake, I will try to resolve my feud with your {relation|C|A} {name|C}.
104659.ch: {call|B|A}，我们同为散修，看在你的面子上，我愿尝试着去化解与你的{relation|C|A}{name|C}之间的仇怨。

104660.en: {call|B|A}, we're both Rogue Cultivators. Any chance you can resolve your feud with my {relation|C|B} {name|C}, for my sake?
104660.ch: {call|B|A}，你我都是散修，看在我的面子上，你与我的{relation|C|B}{name|C}之间的仇怨可否一笔勾销？

104661.en: Even angels and devils can respect one another!
104661.ch: 虽说正魔有别，但阁下的为人却让我很是钦佩！

104662.en: Who cares about good and evil? Someday I'll take you to see my {relation|C|B} {name|C}. {gender|C} is a {post|C} at {school|C}!
104662.ch: 所谓正魔不过虚妄，改日我带你去见我的{relation|C|B}{name|C}，{gender|C}是{school|C}的{post|C}！

104663.en: Don't worry about good and evil. I've got lots of contacts at {school|C}. One word from me, and they'll protect you.
104663.ch: 不必担忧正魔有别，我亲友众多都在{school|C}，只要我告知一声，他们会庇护你。

104664.en: Good and evil shouldn't stop us becoming friends.
104664.ch: 正魔有别，也不碍于你我相交。

104665.en: Good and evil be damned. You're my {relation|A|B}. We'll never turn our backs on each other!
104665.ch: 管它正魔道，你是我的{relation|A|B}，那么我们绝不相背！

104666.en: Good and evil are two different paths. Which one will you take, Disciple?
104666.ch: 正魔殊途，徒儿你要如何自处？

104667.en: Teacher for a day, father for a lifetime. What do I care for good and evil?
104667.ch: 一日为师终身为父，正魔有别与我何干。

104668.en: Good or evil, it's all the same. You and I will always be together.
104668.ch: 正也好魔也罢，你我永远一体同心。

104670.en: Who cares about good and evil? {relation|B|A} will never hurt {relation|A|B}.
104670.ch: 所谓正魔不过虚妄，{relation|B|A}绝不会伤害{relation|A|B}。

104671.en: {relation|A|B}, you and I have taken different paths, but {relation|B|A} will never hurt you.
104671.ch: {relation|A|B}，你我虽然正魔殊途，但{relation|B|A}不会伤害你。

104672.en: You and I get along, but I won't let {name|C} die at your hand.
104672.ch: 与你相交甚是投契，可我也不愿{name|C}死于你手。

104673.en: {call|B|A}, I don't have many friends, but you're right up there.
104673.ch: {call|B|A}，我的知心朋友不多，但你绝对算是我最好的朋友之一。

104674.en: How have you been, my friend?

104675.en: Something bothering you, my friend? Tell me and I can help.
104675.ch: 吾友，近来可有烦难？若有告知，吾可助你。

104677.en: Someone been giving you a hard time, {relation|A|B}? Tell {relation|B|A}. {relation|B|A} will avenge you!
104677.ch: {relation|A|B}，近来可有受人欺负，告诉{relation|B|A}，{relation|B|A}替你出气！

104678.en: Poor is the pupil who does not surpass his master. Every master wants to be bested.
104678.ch: 青出于蓝而更胜于蓝，为师者皆愿如此。

104679.en: Disciple, cultivate yourself until you reach the Master's level! I cannot protect you forever!
104679.ch: 徒儿，你一定要尽快将修为提升到如师父这般！师父无法永远护着你啊！

104680.en: Master, my progress is slow. When will I attain your level?
104680.ch: 师父，徒儿进境缓慢，不知几时才能如你一般境界？

104681.en: Master, I think my level has surpassed your own. I didn't do anything special—just ate 3 square meals a day and went to bed on time. Remarkable. Haha!
104681.ch: 师父，看样子徒儿的境界已经超过你了。明明就什么都没做，只是按时吃饭睡觉，真是不可思议。嘿嘿！

104682.en: {call|B|A}, I remember when we first met. I never imagined you would become so important to me.
104682.ch: {call|B|A}，我还记得第一次与你相见的场景。只是那时的我，并没想到现在你对我是如此重要。

104683.en: {call|B|A}, there is no gentleness in this world... Luckily you're here.
104683.ch: {call|B|A}，这个世界一点都不温柔…还好有你。

104684.en: I don't want you to just walk past me on the street, {call|B|A}. I want to be a main character in the rest of your life.
104684.ch: {call|B|A}，你知道吗？我不想做你的路人，我想做你余生故事里的人。

104685.en: {call|B|A}, you're such a lovely person. You deserve to be with the best... and I hope I can be that person.
104685.ch: {call|B|A}，你是非常可爱的人，真应该遇到最好的人，我也真希望我就是那个最好的人。

104686.en: The days my Lord is near are blessed indeed.
104686.ch: 与君所处的时日中，我受益良多。

104687.en: {call|B|A}, keep working hard on your cultivation so one day we can present ourselves at the temple.
104687.ch: {call|B|A}，为了来日我们能共登殿堂，希望你能努力提升修为。

104688.en: {call|B|A}, countless nights I have closed my eyes and thought of you... It's so nice to meet you.
104688.ch: {call|B|A}，在无数个夜晚中，我闭上眼睛时总是会习惯性的想起你…见到你真好。

104689.en: When I close my eyes my mind fills with images of you...which linger...
104689.ch: 我在闭上眼时，脑海里满满都是你的样子…挥之不去…

104692.en: I don't care if I'm forgotten by the world, as long as we're together... Do you like me, {call|B|A}?
104692.ch: 只要能与你在一起，我不介意被世界所遗忘…{call|B|A}，你喜欢我吗？

104693.en: To be happily married is enough.

104694.en: To hold your hand and grow old together.

104695.en: {relation|A|B}, if you've got a moment, could you give me some pointers on cultivation?
104695.ch: {relation|A|B}，若有闲暇，可否在修行中为我指点一二？

104696.en: {relation|A|B}, I am making headway with my cultivation. If you need anything, just shout.
104696.ch: {relation|A|B}，如今我修为有成，若有所需，只管吩咐便是！

104697.en: {call|B|A}, it stirs the heart to see your cultivation has far surpassed my own!
104697.ch: {call|B|A}，如今你的修为已远超于我，吾心甚慰！

104698.en: {call|B|A}, if someone is giving you trouble, come and get {relation|B|A}. {relation|B|A} will protect you!
104698.ch: {call|B|A}，若是受人欺负了记得来找{relation|B|A}，{relation|B|A}定为你遮风挡雨！

104699.en: I gave the {item} to my {relation|C|B} {name|C} a few days back. I hope {gender|C} liked it...
104699.ch: 前些日子我将{item}孝敬给了我的{relation|C|B}{name|C}，也不知{gender|C}是否喜欢…

104700.en: I gave the {item} to my {relation|C|B} {name|C} a few days back. I hope {gender|C} can use it.
104700.ch: 前些日子我将{item}送给了我的{relation|C|B}{name|C}，希望能对{gender|C}有帮助。

104701.en: I gave the {item} to my {relation|C|B} {name|C}. The child seemed happy enough.
104701.ch: 前些日子我将{item}送给了我的{relation|C|B}{name|C}，那孩子似乎非常开心呢。

104702.en: {call|B|A}, a few days back my {relation|C|B} {name|C} gave me this {item}. Such a nice gesture.
104702.ch: {call|B|A}，我的{relation|C|B}{name|C}在前些日子将{item}送给了我。被人关心的感觉真好。

104703.en: {call|B|A}, a few days back my {relation|C|B} {name|C} gave me this {item}. {gender|C} is so considerate.
104703.ch: {call|B|A}，我的{relation|C|B}{name|C}在前些日子将{item}送给了我。{gender|C}倒是体贴得很…

104704.en: {call|B|A}, a few days back my {relation|C|B} {name|C} gave me this {item}. {gender|C} is such a good child...
104704.ch: {call|B|A}，我的{relation|C|B}{name|C}在前些日子将{item}送给了我。{gender|C}真是个好孩子呢…

104711.en: {name|C} not only defeated me, I was badly injured. I feel so ashamed... Blood for blood, I shall have my vengeance!
104711.ch: 我不仅被{name|C}击败，还身受重伤，实在是无地自容…此仇此怨，今生必报！

104712.en: I had a falling out with my {relation|C|B} and we came to blows. {gender|C} went nuts... and injured me badly.
104712.ch: 我与{relation|C|B}因为一些争执而起了冲突，可{gender|C}下手好狠…我可是伤得不轻。

104713.en: I had a falling out with my {relation|C|B} and we came to blows. I came off second best and {gender|C} wounded me...
104713.ch: 我与我的{relation|C|B}因为一些争执而起了冲突。交手中我竟落了下风，最后还被{gender|C}给伤了…

104714.en: I had a falling out with my {relation|C|B} and we came to blows. It was quite embarrassing really. I didn't just lose, I got injured... I'm gonna to do lots of extra cultivation now!
104714.ch: 我与我的{relation|C|B}因为一些争执而起了冲突。说起来有些丢人，我不仅没占上风，还受了伤…我定要加倍努力修炼！

104719.en: I defeated my {relation|C|B} {name|C}, but spared {gender1|C} life. Maybe I'm a bit too soft...
104719.ch: 先前我击败了我的{relation|C|B}{name|C}，但我还是饶了{gender|C}一命。或许我该心狠一些…

104720.en: {call|B|A}, I had a falling out with my {relation|C|B} {name|C} and we came to blows. I got a bit carried away and really hurt {gender2|C}... Now I'm really worried about {gender2|C}.
104720.ch: {call|B|A}，我与我的{relation|C|B}{name|C}因为一些争执而大打出手，我出手过重伤了{gender|C}…我现在好担心{gender|C}。

104721.en: {call|B|A}, I had a falling out with my {relation|C|B} {name|C} and we came to blows. I think I hurt {gender2|C}... and now I really regret it.
104721.ch: {call|B|A}，我与我的{relation|C|B}{name|C}因为一些争执而大打出手，我似乎伤了{gender|C}…我现在好后悔。

104722.en: {call|B|A}, I had a falling out with my {relation|C|B} {name|C} and we came to blows. I got a bit carried away and really hurt {gender2|C}... Now I wonder if the kid hates me.
104722.ch: {call|B|A}，我与我的{relation|C|B}{name|C}因为一些争执而大打出手，我出手过重伤了{gender|C}…也不知那孩子会不会记恨于我。

104723.en: I defeated my {relation|C|B} {name|C}, but I still let {gender|C} get away...
104723.ch: 先前我击败了我的{relation|C|B}{name|C}，但还是让{gender|C}逃脱了…

104725.en: {call|B|A}, I had a falling out with my {relation|C|B} {name|C} and we came to blows. I think I hurt {gender2|C}... and now I really regret it...
104725.ch: {call|B|A}，我与我的{relation|C|B}{name|C}因为一些争执而大打出手，我似乎伤了{gender|C}…我现在好后悔…

104727.en: My {relation|C|B} {name|C} was eventually killed in battle... by me.
104727.ch: 我的{relation|C|B}{name|C}，终于是在先前的战斗中被我给杀了…

104728.en: I didn't realize my {relation|C|B} {name|C} is actually your {relation|C|A}. We are basically family now.
104728.ch: 没想到我的{relation|C|B}{name|C}竟是你的{relation|C|A}，我们可要多亲近亲近。

104729.en: Half a sentence is too much when there is no meeting of minds. Farewell.

104730.en: Talking to you is truly an assault on the senses!
104730.ch: 似你这般形陋，也配与我交谈，简直污人耳目！

104731.en: God you're repulsive! Get away from me!
104731.ch: 你这歪瓜裂枣，简直污人耳目！离我远些！

104732.en: You go your way and I go mine. No need to discuss it.
104732.ch: 道不同不相为谋，无需多言。

104733.en: You dare to show your face around here? Don't tempt me!
104733.ch: 你竟然还敢出现在我面前？！可别让我逮着了机会！

104734.en: What are you doing, fooling around here? Scram!
104734.ch: 别在我面前瞎晃悠，快滚！

104735.en: Don't think I won't mess you up just because we belong to the same Sect!
104735.ch: 不要以为咱两是同门我就不会将你如何！

104736.en: {name|C} isn't here now. Don't think anyone's going to protect you!
104736.ch: {name|C}现在可不在这里，别想着会有人保护你！

104737.en: {name|C} must have been blind to swear brotherhood with you. Get lost!
104737.ch: {name|C}真是瞎了眼才会与你这种人结义，快滚！

104738.en: You and {name|C} are cut from the same cloth. One day I'll make both of you pay!
104738.ch: 你与{name|C}简直就是一丘之貉，总有一天我会让你们付出代价！

104739.en: I'll kill you AND {name|C}! One day I'll make both of you pay!
104739.ch: 你与{name|C}我一个都不会放过！总有一天我会让你们付出代价！

104740.en: It's no wonder {name|C} despises you. I'll make you pay, if I get a chance!
104740.ch: 也难怪{name|C}会如此厌恶你，若有机会我定会让你付出代价！

104741.en: {call|B|A}! You know traveling alone is very dangerous, right?! If you die, no one's coming to get your body. Understand?
104741.ch: 这不是{call|B|A}嘛！独自一人在外可是很危险的，若是被人杀了连个能帮你收尸的人都没有，你觉得呢？

104742.en: {call|B|A}! Long time no see! I thought you were dead!
104742.ch: 这不是{call|B|A}嘛！许久未见，原来你还活着呢！

104743.en: The Master sure has good taste in Disciples! I don't know what he sees in you!
104743.ch: 师父可真是收了个好弟子呢！也不知是看上了你哪一点。

104745.en: {name|C} 's biggest mistake was making friends with you.
104745.ch: {name|C}一生中所犯最大的错误便是结识了你。

104746.en: You and {name|C} are cut from the same cloth. One day you'll pay a terrible price, I swear it!
104746.ch: 你与{name|C}简直就是一丘之貉，总有一天我定让你们付出惨痛的代价！

104747.en: {name|C} must hate you for a reason.
104747.ch: {name|C}如此仇视你，并不是没有理由的。

104749.en: {call|B|A}, you know traveling alone is very dangerous, right?
104749.ch: {call|B|A}，独自一人在外可是很危险的。

104763.en: ...To become immortal, first perfect being human.

104764.en: Don't think you'll can do whatever you want, just because you're {post|A}. One day I'll trample you underfoot!
104764.ch: 莫要以为你是{post|A}便可肆无忌惮，终有一日我会将你踩在脚下！

104765.en: Cultivation, schmultivation, I outrank you here.
104765.ch: 境界高又如何，在宗门中不也得屈居于我之下。

104766.en: It doesn't matter how fast you cultivate {name|C}! If you piss me off, I can still make life very difficult for you!
104766.ch: {name|C}，修炼进度再快，境界再高又如何？！得罪了我，以我在宗门的地位权势你不还是任我揉捏！

104768.en: {call|B|A}, you have a low rank and your cultivation sucks! If I want to, I can squash you like an ant!
104768.ch: {call|B|A}，你修为低下，地位更是不如我，要弄死你就像捏死蚂蚁一样容易！

104769.en: You and {name|C} just wait. I'll hunt you down, one by one!
104769.ch: 你和{name|C}都给我等着，我会一一找你们两个算账的！

104770.en: {call|B|A}, {name|C} says {gender|C} wants you—wants you dead, that is!

104771.en: {call|B|A}, {name|C} says hi. {name|C} hasn't forgotten what you did and will pay you back given half a chance. Hah!
104771.ch: {call|B|A}，{name|C}托我“问候”你，你对{name|C}的所作所为，{name|C}不会忘记，一有机会，会好好“回报”你。哼！

104772.en: {call|B|A}, rumor has it you are throwing your weight around in the {school|A}. Keep it up and see how long you last!
104772.ch: {call|B|A}，听说你仗着自身修为在{school|A}作威作福，多行不义必自毙！

104773.en: We meet again, {school|A} runt! Still got a chip on your shoulder?
104773.ch: {school|A}的小辈，咱们又见面了，前日之怨你可还记得！

104774.en: How dare you insult me! Do you realize the {school|C} {post|C} {name|C} is my {relation|C|B}?

104775.en: I have lots of contacts at {school|C}. Insult me and they will have something to say about it.
104775.ch: 我在{school|C}亲友众多，得罪了我他们不会放过你。

104776.en: {name|A} of {school|A}, I bear a grudge against you and your {relation|C|A} {name|C} and I'm not gonna let it go.
104776.ch: {school|A}的{name|A}，你和你的{relation|C|A}{name|C}，你们跟我都有仇，我都不会放过的！

104777.en: {name|A} of {school|A}, I hear you are feuding with my {relation|C|B} {name|C}. Careful or I'll join forces with {gender2|C}!
104777.ch: {school|A}的{name|A}，听说你与我的{relation|C|B}{name|C}也有仇，小心我联合{gender|C}一起对付你！

104778.en: {school|A} is really something! I'd love to study there. Shame they admit students like you.
104778.ch: {school|A}威名赫赫，我心慕已久，哼，可惜却收了如你这般的人入门。

104779.en: If it isn't {name|A} from {school|A}! Has the little mouse come out of its hole to play?
104779.ch: 这不是{school|A}的{name|A}嘛！小老鼠不躲在洞穴里出来找死吗？！

104780.en: {name|A} of {school|A} is surprisingly good! I might be humble Rogue Cultivator, but today's humiliation will be repaid with interest!
104780.ch: {school|A}{name|A}果然厉害，我一介散修力小微薄，但今日所受的屈辱，来日必当加倍奉还！

104781.ch: {school|A}的高徒竟是这般做派，真让人不齿。

104782.en: {call|B|A}, don't think the {school|A} will protect you from a Rogue Cultivator like me forever. I'll bide my time and then one day... Kapow!
104782.ch: {call|B|A}，别以为有{school|A}的庇护我这散修奈何不得你，终有一日我会找到机会将你除去，你等着吧！

104783.en: Your aimless loitering brings dishonor to the {school|A}.
104783.ch: 终日浪荡，不堪如你也真是污了{school|A}的名声。

104784.en: I might be a humble Rogue Cultivator, but my {relation|C|B} {name|C} is a {post|C} at {school|C}... so mind your tongue!
104784.ch: 我虽只是一介散修，但我的{relation|C|B}{name|C}却是{school|C}的{post|C}，欺辱了我，给我小心点！

104785.en: Provoke me and you provoke the {post|C} of {school|C}!

104786.en: Don't think you can push me around just because I'm a Rogue Cultivator. I have lots of contacts at {school|C}!
104786.ch: 别以为我是散修就可以轻易欺辱我，我亲友众多皆在{school|C}！

120002.en: (Let's try and talk to {name|B}. Hmm, what should I say?)

120053.en: ({name|B} looks at me with a bemused expression.)

120072.en: Though we have only just met, I already feel a deep connection with you.
120072.ch: 初次见面却已觉得与阁下十分投缘。

120090.ch: {call|B|A}，你的修为似乎又精进了不少！

120091.en: I trust you have been well, {call|B|A}!

120093.en: Tell me, {call|B|A}, what Adventures have you gone on since we parted last?

120094.en: {call|B|A}, I have been thinking of you since we parted last.

120095.en: Congratulations, {call|B|A}! Your Cultivation has reached new heights!
120095.ch: {call|B|A}，你的修为境界又进一重，可喜可贺啊！

120100.en: No wonder our conversations flow without end; we are brothers of the same Sect!
120100.ch: 与阁下实有说不尽的话题，原来竟是同门兄弟。

120101.en: Master has always had high standards, but it was small wonder that he took in someone with your potential.
120101.ch: 你颇有潜质，而师父眼光一向甚高，难怪将你收入门下

120102.en: Haha, now I know why Master has been neglecting me of late, in favor of a gifted Disciple like you.

120105.en: As you are {relation|B|C} with {name|C}, so too am I your {relation|B|A}.

120121.en: It seems that {name|C} is your {relation|C|A}. If and when I take revenge against {gender|2}, would you thwart me?

120141.en: {name|C} is my {relation|C|B}. I can hardly stand by if you mean to exact revenge on them. Better for you to give this up and let go of your hatred.

120142.en: Would you take pity on me and let bygones be bygones with {name|C}?

120160.en: You and your {relation|C|A}, {name|C}, are truly of the same ilk!

120161.en: So {name|C} is your {relation|C|A}. I suppose birds of a feather do flock together!

120162.en: You and your {relation|C|A}, {name|C}, are truly cut from the same cloth.
120162.ch: 阁下与你{relation|C|A}{name|C}说是狼狈为奸也不为过。

120180.ch: 前辈实力强大，若蒙指点，晚辈修为必有长进。

120181.ch: 晚辈心中颇有疑惑，想请前辈印证所想，还请指教！

120182.en: There's still something I don't understand. I hope you'll be so kind as to teach me!

120200.en: {call|B|A}, the responsibility of spreading the name of our sect all falls on your shoulders!
120200.ch: {call|B|A}，光大宗门门楣的重任就落在你身上了！

120260.en: {name|C} is my {relation|C|B}. Won't you put aside your resentment out of my name?
120260.ch: {name|C}是我的{relation|C|B}，可否给我几分薄面，不再向他寻仇？

120282.en: I never thought you'd be the {post|A} of {school|A}. I have long since heard of your good name! It is an honor to meet you!

120341.en: My numerous friends at {school|C} have taken care of me on many an occasion. If you are ever in trouble, I can appeal to them for help.

120420.ch: {school|A}不是安身立命的地方，赶紧离去吧。

120421.en: {school|A} is a nest of wolves, a cavern of pythons. You'd best leave as soon as you can!
120421.ch: {school|A}是豺狼的穴，蟒蛇的窟，盼你早早离开为是！

120422.en: The disciples of your sect lack disciple, and not all are of respectable character. This is a far cry from the {school|A} that once was.
120422.ch: 你宗门里面的弟子都十分散漫，良莠不齐，早已经不是当年的{school|A}了。

120440.en: As a rogue cultivator, I have long had unmeasurable envy of your being at {school|A}.
120440.ch: 作为散修，我对进入{school|A}的你总有说不尽的羡慕。

120441.en: {school|A}'s name is known far and wide. My jealousy as a rogue cultivator cannot be overstated.
120441.ch: {school|A}名闻八荒，好叫我一介散修羡慕不已。

120442.en: I, {name|B}, am but a rogue cultivator. I am humbled to stand in the presence of someone from {school|A} such as you.
120442.ch: 在下是散修{name|B}，与身属{school|A}的你见面，觉得十分荣幸。

120460.en: Your sect {school|A} has influence across the land. While I may be a rogue cultivator, but I get to live a free and unfettered life. What do you think?
120460.ch: 你的宗门{school|A}是八荒大宗，我虽是散修，却胜在逍遥自在，你以为呢？

120461.en: {school|A} may be out of the ordinary, but having followed my path all the way through, I do think I can rival a sect disciple. Come to me if you have any troubles.
120461.ch: {school|A}虽然不凡，但我自问一身道法亦不输宗弟子，你有难处也可以找我。

120462.en: I may not have the sheer number of capable people at the great {school|A}, but you can count on me for help should you need it.
120462.ch: 我虽然不比{school|A}高门大户能人众多，但你遇有困难亦可助你一臂之力。

120480.en: I may be a mere rogue cultivator, but the {post|C} of {school|C} is in fact my {relation|C|B}.
120480.ch: 眼下我只是一个散修，但{school|C}{post|C}却是我{relation|C|B}。

120481.en: To have the {post|C} of {school|C} as my {relation|C|B} is the utmost honor.
120481.ch: 蒙{school|C}{post|C}不弃，成为我的{relation|C|B}，真叫我感到荣幸呢。

120482.en: For the {post|C} of {school|C} to recognize me so, and even deign to make me their {relation|C|B} was hitherto unfathomable for me.
120482.ch: {school|C}的{post|C}没有看不起我一介散修，竟屈尊当我的{relation|C|B}，真叫我意想不到。

120500.en: Many a friend of mine has enrolled at {school|C}. Only I never had the opportunity, and settled for the life of a rogue cultivator.
120500.ch: 往日众多好友都成为{school|C}门人，只有我未得机缘，始终是一名散修。

120501.en: As a rogue cultivator, none were ever willing to shield me. How fortunate I am that my friends who have entered {school|C} have steadfastly stood by me.
120501.ch: 作为一名散修始终无人庇护，所幸昔日好友加入{school|C}后对我始终不离不弃。

120502.en: If those old friends of mine who, one by one, enrolled at {school|C} had not taken care of me on many an occasion, my life as a rogue cultivator would be a harsh one indeed.
120502.ch: 想我往日好友都一一进入{school|C}，若非他们时常照拂，我一个散修必定过得很艰难了。

120520.en: {name|A}! Your {relation|C|A}, {name|C}, has inflicted all manner of abuse against me, evidently over your identity as a disciple of {school|A}!
120520.ch: {name|A}！你的{relation|C|A}{name|C}，仗着你是{school|A}弟子，对我一介散修百般欺压！

120521.en: Your {relation|C|A}, {name|C}, has wronged me time and time again! Were you not from {school|A}, I would long since have disregarded my role as rogue cultivator and made {gender2|C} regret it!
120521.ch: 你的{relation|C|A}{name|C}屡屡得罪于我，若非看在你是{school|A}门下，即使我只一个散修也要重重惩治{gender|C}了！

120522.en: Your {relation|C|A}, {name|C}, has repeatedly provoked me over your joining {school|A}. I may be a rogue cultivator, but I fear {gender2|C} not in the slightest.
120522.ch: 你的{relation|C|A}{name|C}仗着你是{school|A}门人时常挑衅我，我虽是一个散修，却不怕{gender|C}。

120540.en: {name|A}, of {school|A}. My {relation|C|B}, {name|C}, has wronged you, and I beg you to forgive {gender2|C}.
120540.ch: {name|A}，你乃{school|A}的门人，我的{relation|C|B}{name|C}曾得罪你，盼你对{gender|C}多多包涵。

120541.en: My {relation|C|B}, {name|C}, has wronged you many a time. Had you and {school|A} not shown mercy numerous times, I fear {gender2|C} would long since have perished.
120541.ch: 我的{relation|C|B}{name|C}屡次冒犯于你，若非你与你的宗门{school|A}多次宽宥，只怕{gender|C}早已死于非命。

120542.en: The {school|A} followers have consistently shown greatness. My {relation|C|B}, {name|C}, has only me, a rogue cultivator, for a friend. Please show mercy.
120542.ch: {school|A}的门人一向大度，我的{relation|C|B}{name|C}只有我一个散修朋友，还盼见谅。

120560.en: {school|A} inspires awe across the land. Being a mere rogue cultivator, I have deeply wished to join your sect but have thus far never had the opportunity.
120560.ch: {school|A}威镇八荒，我作为一名散修，十分向往你的宗门，不过未得机缘进入罢了。

120561.en: Only a prestigious sect like {school|A} can foster talents as great as yours!
120561.ch: 我一向觉得只有{school|A}这样优秀的宗门，才能培养出阁下一般的人才！

120562.en: I've always known {school|A} to have a great reputation across the land. Would you give me a referral as a disciple there?
120562.ch: 我以为{school|A}声威远播，是八荒大宗，你作为该宗弟子，可否将我引荐入门？

120580.en: {call|B|A}, your sect {school|A} is guilty of serious misdeeds. Why not pursue the clean and honest living of a rogue cultivator like me?
120580.ch: {call|B|A}，你的宗门{school|A}藏污纳垢，不如学我洁身自好做一名散修。

120581.en: {school|A} houses both the noble and the ignoble. Your majesty is a modest and upright figure. You ought not to get mixed up with those types!
120581.ch: {school|A}之中良莠不齐，阁下潇洒正直，不该与他们作一路啊！

120582.en: {call|B|A}, why must you be controlled by {school|A}? Would not a life like mine, a mere rogue cultivator, be more liberating?
120582.ch: {call|B|A}，何必受{school|A}控制？似我虽则区区散修，不也潇洒自在？

120600.en: If I were you, I would long since have left {school|A}, corrupt as it is.
120600.ch: 我要是你一定早早离开{school|A}这个肮脏的宗门。

120601.en: One as decent as you ought not to associate with {school|A}.
120601.ch: 你这样的好人品，是不该与{school|A}为伍的。

120602.en: One as majestic as you can do far better in somewhere than a place as impure as {school|A}.
120602.ch: 似阁下这样好的品格，何苦陷身{school|A}这滩污泥之中？

120620.en: I've heard that {name|C} is the {post|C} at {school|A}. With {gender1|C} support and continuous aid, I am indeed humbled.
120620.ch: 听闻{name|C}是你{school|A}的{post|C}，蒙{gender|C}不弃，始终对我这名散修多加提携，可真是荣幸。

120621.en: The {post|C} of your sect {school|A}, {name|C}, is in fact my {relation|C|B}.

120622.en: My {relation|C|B}, {name|C}, is the {school|A} {post|C}, and {gender|C} has mentioned you to me.

120640.en: Though you may be a rogue cultivator, you have reached the realm of {grade|A}, even surpassing me. Would you like to join {school|B}?
120640.ch: 阁下虽是散修，却身负{grade|A}修为，比在下都要来得高明，何不加入到{school|B}来呢？

120641.en: My sect {school|B} seeks those worthy as the thirsty seeks water. We would love to have a great {grade|A} rogue cultivator like you!
120641.ch: 在下的宗门{school|B}一向求贤若渴，正爱您这等{grade|A}修为的散修英才！

120642.en: You are on the realm of {grade|A}. As a rogue cultivator, my only fear is you struggling to progress further. {school|B} has a wealth of talent amongst its numbers, and they would surely help you break through your bottleneck.
120642.ch: 你已臻{grade|A}之境，作为散修只怕很难再有寸进，{school|B}中人才济济，或能帮你突破瓶颈。

120660.en: A rogue cultivator struggles alone, and I fear that you will scarcely be able to make your way further in the world. Why not join us at {school|B}?
120660.ch: 散修孤立无援，只怕于八荒之中寸步难行，不如加入我{school|B}如何？

120661.en: {call|B|A}, join {school|B}. We would without a doubt become a great help to each other as fellow students.
120661.ch: {call|B|A}，加入{school|B}，我们岂不好作个同门互相照应么？

120662.en: I've always wanted a peer to study alongside. Join {school|B}, and we'll be able to take great care of each other.
120662.ch: 我一直希望能有你这样一位同门。若加入{school|B}，我定必对你多加照顾。

120680.en: Rogue Cultivators have many difficulties. My {relation|C|B}, {name|C}, is the {school|C} {post|C}. If you enroll at {school|C}, I'm sure {gender|C} would be of great help to you.
120680.ch: 散修多有难题，我{relation|C|B}{name|C}是{school|C}的{post|C}，加入{school|C}，{gender|C}必能对你多加照顾。

120681.en: You have nary a friend throughout the land, and it must be hard to live free of trouble. How about I ask the {school|C} {post|C}, {name|C}, to help you out?
120681.ch: 你在八荒之中孤身闯荡，难免遇见问题，我请{school|C}的{post|C}{name|C}帮助你如何？

120682.en: The {school|C} {post|C}, {name|C}, is my {relation|C|B} and would be of great help should I request it, even if I am a rogue cultivator.
120682.ch: {school|C}的{post|C}{name|C}乃是我的{relation|C|B}，若我拜托，即便是散修他亦往往倾力相助。

120700.en: If your skills as a rogue cultivator become any greater, your life of solitude will become all the more difficult. If you join {school|C}, I can request for my sect friends to help you. How about it?
120700.ch: 你一个散修本领再高，独身闯荡总是十分艰难。加入{school|C}后，我能请托宗门朋友帮助你，如何？

120701.en: I have many friends at {school|C}, and they are more than willing to help others. Why not ask directly if you're having trouble?
120701.ch: 我在{school|C}有许多好友，他们乐于结交帮助别个，你若有困难，不妨直说？

120702.en: All my friends have enrolled at {school|C}, and they are more than willing to help rogue cultivators. Naturally, you would be no exception.
120702.ch: 我的朋友们都进入{school|C}了，他们都愿意帮助散修，当然你也不例外。

120720.en: You truly excel even as a rogue cultivator. Even your esteemed peers pale in comparison to you.
120720.ch: 你作为散修，仍然超群绝伦，阁下朋友的人品却与你差远了。

120721.en: Your {relation|C|A}, {name|C}, is simply vile, and needs to be better admonished. Else, I will have my disciples in the sect retaliate against {gender2|C}.
120721.ch: 你的{relation|C|A}{name|C}人品恶劣，请你多多劝诫，不然我要联合宗门中的弟子对{gender|C}进行报复了。

120722.en: Your {relation|C|A}, {name|C}, ought to learn from your noble manner. That way I would have no grudge to bear against {gender2|C}!
120722.ch: 你{relation|C|A}{name|C}应该好好学习你的胸襟气度，如此一来，我就不必跟{gender|C}结怨了！

120740.en: Your future as a rogue cultivator is sure to be a hard one. It would do you well to clear your history with my {relation|C|B}, {name|C}, no?
120740.ch: 你作为散修，前途一定满布困难，不若与我{relation|C|B}{name|C}泯去恩怨，如何？

120741.en: I am rather in admiration of you compared to other rogue cultivators. I'd like to invite you to reconcile with my {relation|C|B}, {name|C}. What do you say?
120741.ch: 散修之中，我对你颇为佩服，所以想请你与我{relation|C|B}{name|C}两家讲和，可好？

120742.en: As a rogue cultivator, you are indeed of noble character, and my {relation|C|B}, {name|C}, too, is far from any type of villain. Why not make {gender2|C} as your friend instead of your enemy?
120742.ch: 你作为散修，品格高尚，我一向敬重，而我{relation|C|B}{name|C}也非十恶不赦之人，与{gender|C}化敌为友如何？

120760.en: For you, as a rogue cultivator, to not only be {name|C}'s {relation|C|A}, but also for {gender2|C} to be the {school|C} {post|C}...!
120760.ch: 你作为一名散修竟是{name|C}{relation|C|A}，而{gender|C}还是{school|C}的{post|C}！
